accepted.s: The World Heritage Convention was adopted in which year?
accepted.x: The World Heritage Convention was adopted in 1972.
accepted.tq: Use the direct year-recall approach for a foundational convention.
accepted.sec: UNESCO - World Heritage, Creative Cities, ICH, Memory of the World

accepted.s:
For inscription of a property on the UNESCO World Heritage List, which of the following conditions is required?
1. Prior entry on the Tentative List
2. Demonstration of Outstanding Universal Value
3. Fulfilment of at least one of the ten selection criteria
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three conditions are required: the property must first be on the Tentative List, possess Outstanding Universal Value and satisfy at least one of the ten criteria.
accepted.tq: Check each procedural requirement separately before selecting the complete combination.
accepted.sec: UNESCO - World Heritage, Creative Cities, ICH, Memory of the World

accepted.s: As of July 2026, how many properties were included in the UNESCO World Heritage List?
accepted.x: The World Heritage List contained 1,273 properties as of July 2026.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the total figure from the component categories and nearby numerical distractors.
accepted.sec: UNESCO - World Heritage, Creative Cities, ICH, Memory of the World

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly represents the composition of the UNESCO World Heritage List as of July 2026?
accepted.x: The List comprised 991 cultural, 240 natural and 42 mixed properties.
accepted.tq: Compare the category labels with their exact numerical values rather than matching numbers alone.
accepted.sec: UNESCO - World Heritage, Creative Cities, ICH, Memory of the World

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs of countries and numbers of World Heritage properties, as of July 2026, is correctly matched?
accepted.x: Italy had 62 World Heritage properties and China had 61 as of July 2026.
accepted.tq: Use the comparison row directly and watch for a reversal of the two countries.
accepted.sec: UNESCO - World Heritage, Creative Cities, ICH, Memory of the World

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer using the code given below the lists.

List-I (Indian inscription)
a. Sarnath
b. Maratha Military Landscapes
c. Yoga

a. Bhagavad Gita manuscripts

List-II (Session or year/register)
i. 48th World Heritage Committee, Busan, 2026
ii. 47th World Heritage Committee, Paris, 2025
iii. Intangible Cultural Heritage, 2016
iv. Memory of the World International Register

The correct matching is:
accepted.x: Sarnath corresponds to the 48th WHC at Busan in 2026; Maratha Military Landscapes to the 47th WHC at Paris in 2025; Yoga to ICH in 2016; and Bhagavad Gita manuscripts to the Memory of the World International Register.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure year-session pairs and eliminate codes containing a reversed or misplaced pair.
accepted.sec: UNESCO - World Heritage, Creative Cities, ICH, Memory of the World

accepted.s: Which of the following groups consists entirely of entries in the UNESCO Memory of the World registers?
o: Bhagavad Gita manuscripts, Natyashastra of Bharatamuni, Ramacharitamanasa
accepted.x: Ramacharitamanasa, Sahrdayaloka-Locana and Panchatantra are entries in the MOWCAP Regional Register. The Bhagavad Gita manuscripts and Natyashastra of Bharatamuni are in the International Register.
accepted.tq: Separate the International Register from the MOWCAP Regional Register before judging the group.
accepted.sec: UNESCO - World Heritage, Creative Cities, ICH, Memory of the World

accepted.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched with the UNESCO Memory of the World register concerned?
o: Natyashastra of Bharatamuni — MOWCAP Regional Register
Bhagavad Gita manuscripts — MOWCAP Regional Register
Panchatantra — Memory of the World International Register
accepted.x: Sahrdayaloka-Locana is included in the MOWCAP Regional Register. The Bhagavad Gita manuscripts and Natyashastra are in the International Register, while Panchatantra is in the MOWCAP Regional Register.
accepted.tq: Find the one correctly matched pair after separating the two closely named registers.
accepted.sec: UNESCO - World Heritage, Creative Cities, ICH, Memory of the World

accepted.s: The 2025 cycle of the UNESCO Creative Cities Network added Indian cities in which of the following fields?
accepted.x: The 2025 cycle added Indian cities as Cities of Gastronomy and Cities of Music.
accepted.tq: Use the exact category pair and avoid substituting other Creative Cities fields.
accepted.sec: UNESCO - World Heritage, Creative Cities, ICH, Memory of the World

accepted.s: The Nobel Peace Prize awarded to the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR) was received in which years?
accepted.x: UNHCR received the Nobel Peace Prize in 1954 and again in 1981.
accepted.tq: Pair the organisation with its distinctive two-year Nobel record.
accepted.sec: UN bodies awarded the Nobel Peace Prize

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer using the code given below the lists.

List-I (Body or recipient)
a. UNICEF
b. ILO
c. UN Peacekeeping Forces
d. UN and Kofi Annan

List-II (Year)
i. 1965
ii. 1969
iii. 1988
iv. 2001

The correct matching is:
accepted.x: UNICEF won in 1965, ILO in 1969, the UN Peacekeeping Forces in 1988, and the UN together with Kofi Annan in 2001.
accepted.tq: Begin with the organisation-year pairs that are most distinctive and verify the complete code.
accepted.sec: UN bodies awarded the Nobel Peace Prize

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
accepted.x: WFP received the Nobel Peace Prize in 2020, not 2019. IAEA and ElBaradei, IPCC and Al Gore, and OPCW correspond to 2005, 2007 and 2013 respectively.
accepted.tq: Use the NOT formulation to identify the altered year in an otherwise familiar Nobel sequence.
accepted.sec: UN bodies awarded the Nobel Peace Prize

accepted.s: The Nobel Peace Prize awarded to the IPCC in 2007 was shared equally with whom?
accepted.x: The IPCC shared the 2007 Nobel Peace Prize equally with Al Gore.
accepted.tq: Test the named co-recipient rather than merely recalling the award year.
accepted.sec: UN bodies awarded the Nobel Peace Prize

accepted.s:
The 2020 Nobel Peace Prize awarded to the World Food Programme recognised its contribution primarily to:
1. Combating hunger
2. Improving conditions for peace in conflict areas
3. Expanding the UNESCO Creative Cities Network
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The WFP was recognised for combating hunger and improving conditions for peace in conflict areas. Expansion of the UNESCO Creative Cities Network was not the basis of the award.
accepted.tq: Separate the award citation from an unrelated UNESCO function.
accepted.sec: UN bodies awarded the Nobel Peace Prize

accepted.s: World Health Day is observed on 7 April under the leadership of which United Nations specialised agency?
accepted.x: World Health Day is observed on 7 April and is associated with the World Health Organization.
accepted.tq: Match the subject of the day—health—with the responsible agency.
accepted.sec: International Days → UN agency

accepted.s:
Consider the following pairs:
1. World Environment Day — 5 June — UNEP
2. World Refugee Day — 20 June — UNHCR
3. International Day of Yoga — 21 June — UN General Assembly
4. World Food Day — 16 October — FAO
Which of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
accepted.x: All four pairs are correct: World Environment Day is linked to UNEP, World Refugee Day to UNHCR, International Day of Yoga to the UN General Assembly, and World Food Day to FAO.
accepted.tq: Verify each day against both its date and its agency before choosing the complete set.
accepted.sec: International Days → UN agency

accepted.s:
Which one of the following sequences arranges the following international days in chronological order within a calendar year?
A. World Health Day
B. World Environment Day
C. World Refugee Day
D. World Food Day
accepted.x: The dates are 7 April, 5 June, 20 June and 16 October respectively, giving the order World Health Day, World Environment Day, World Refugee Day and World Food Day.
accepted.tq: Arrange the events by their calendar dates, using the first and last dates as anchors.
accepted.sec: International Days → UN agency

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
accepted.x: International Day of Yoga is associated with the UN General Assembly, not UNHCR.
accepted.tq: Identify the agency substitution in a familiar day-agency pairing.
accepted.sec: International Days → UN agency

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements correctly describes the role of United Nations agencies?
1. They facilitate global cooperation in health and food.
2. They address refugee protection and environmental cooperation.
3. Their functions are confined exclusively to peacekeeping operations.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: UN agencies support cooperation in health, food, refugee protection, education and environmental matters. Their functions are not confined exclusively to peacekeeping.
accepted.tq: Reject the extreme word “exclusively” when it improperly narrows a broad institutional role.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: The United States memorandum referred to in April 2026 proposed withdrawal from how many United Nations entities and how many non-United Nations bodies?
accepted.x: The memorandum proposed quitting 31 UN entities and 35 non-UN bodies.
accepted.tq: Keep the two counts in their correct institutional categories and watch for reversal.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s:
Which of the following organisations were included among those named in the April 2026 United States memorandum?
1. WHO
2. UNFPA
3. UN Women
4. UNFCCC and IPCC
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The memorandum named WHO, UNFPA, UN Women, UNFCCC and IPCC among the bodies concerned.
accepted.tq: Test completeness across a list of similarly named international organisations.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: India signed a five-year rice supply agreement in 2026 with which organisation?
accepted.x: India signed a five-year rice supply agreement with the World Food Programme in 2026.
accepted.tq: Apply the “food supply” clue to distinguish WFP from other UN agencies.
accepted.sec: Universal angles
